actual_proofs: Actual owned TLS/ACL Valkey FLUSHDB/stop/same-CID restart on fixed endpoint; original adapter configuration unchanged reconnects and restores hints.
Product code publishes short TTL opaque hints after governed PG commit, not test-side fabricated SET. Cache stopped still accepts/replays same PG task.
Current governed PG claim/inspect/finish preserves authoritative work: two queue jobs succeeded, zero formal ontology objects written by the cache path.

Actual standalone RuntimeWorker private CLI config: cache disabled, available and stopped variants each finish real PG task and actual Node24 Pi SQLite FULL single submission. Runtime success is not business fulfillment.
API readiness independently exposes cache configured/available/degraded/authoritative=false. Actual TestClient response shows cache degradation and recovery while product_ready remains false.
TLS SAN-only, wrong credentials, public credential file, foreign key, CONFIG and FLUSHDB client permissions denied.

Literal IP host only; hostname/multiple-address configurations rejected before resolution. Actual literal Valkey works with getaddrinfo forbidden. One socket family, one numeric connect, deadline starts before connect and remains through TLS/RESP.

Actual owned accepted TCP with stalled TLS handshake and trickled TLS response respect cache deadline; original PG committed ACK/pending task remain. Saturated TCP listener actually returned macOS reset, reported as unavailable rather than slow-SYN timeout.

RuntimeDispatcher preflight rejects cache timeout above min(lease,total budget)/6 before claim; actual short-lease task stays pending/fence0 with no runtime.sqlite. Default PG polling always continues regardless hint value/failure.
limits: Focused67 is not full repository CI or completion of NX-017.
No persistent deployment, Compose cache secret mount rollout or production database access.
Readiness cache HTTP proof uses FastAPI TestClient and actual TLS cache; not an independent Human browser acceptance.
Deterministic provider only in Worker/Pi tests; business_action_success=false, not actual model/channel/effect fulfillment.
Cache hint reconstruction covers actual claimed work and bounded recent task IDs rechecked by governed inspect, not full pending snapshot/historical notification replay.
Standalone AdvisoryQueueScheduler may sequentially maintain up to64 hints; entire helper tick has no realtime guarantee. Actual RuntimeDispatcher does not use that maintenance loop.
host requires explicit unscoped literal IPv4/IPv6; server_name is TLS verification name only. No model/environment hostnames are automatically resolved or deployment addresses guessed.
No generic exactly-once claim, no authority, credential, lease or business body stored in Valkey.
cleanup: Owned cache containers were exact CID/ownership-label verified and removed; disposable PG and owned processes handled by fixtures. No unrelated service stopped.
